title: Brand amber and gold text fail colour contrast across most pages
location: raw Tailwind classes text-amber-600 / #d4af37 across components
steps: node scripts/browser/a11y-scan.cjs (axe-core 4.10.3, WCAG 2.0–2.2 A/AA) — light theme
node scratch themes check — dark theme
expected: Text ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 for large text) in light and dark themes.
actual: 123 failing elements on 27 of 36 page states (light). Main pairs: #e17100 on white 3.2:1, #e17100 on #f7f7f7 2.99:1, gold #d4af37 on white 2.1:1, white on #d4af37 2.1:1, white on amber #fe9a00 2.14:1, muted #6a7181 on #f0f2f4 4.35:1. Dark theme: 1–9 failures per page checked (landing 7, feed 9).
impact: Prices, badges and secondary labels are hard to read for low-vision users and in sunlight on phones — common for the target market.
fix: Define accessible brand tokens in globals.css (e.g. amber text ≥ #b45309 on white, gold only for decoration or with dark text), replace raw amber/gold text classes with the tokens, and add axe color-contrast to CI.
